S1_STARTER_ACTUAL.cell_notes: Starter = QB with most offensive snaps (ties fail closed). Post-game actual: retrospective by construction; prior games' starters are legitimate inputs for later games under the completion-window safeguard.

S2_SNAP_COUNTS.cell_notes: Source carries NO timestamps; publication lag is documented (~1 day, PFR) but NOT measured from this source. Classified retrospectively per owner rule.

observation_lag_evidence.basis: date_modified bookkeeping timestamp vs kickoff (UNTRUSTED as publication proof -- foundation S3 risk 2; classification rests on cadence)

S3_INJURY_DESIGNATIONS.cell_notes: Final-report rule: designations are public pre-kickoff by league cadence (24-48h). No revision history exists; date_modified is the feed's bookkeeping, not a publication receipt.

S4_PRACTICE_STATUS.cell_notes: Weekly snapshot only; per-day progression is NOT reconstructible (forward-capture class). Restricted use.

observation_lag_evidence.basis: weekly snapshot granularity under prior-week lag rule; lag = kickoff minus snapshot week-conclusion bound, in days

S5_ROSTER_RESERVE.cell_notes: Status codes are a coarse bucket (RES/PUP/...); reserve SUBTYPE rides on opaque status_description_abbr codes with no in-file codebook and is unresolved. Snapshot compilation time inside the week is unknown -- prior-week rule is the conservative consequence (Week 1 uncovered).

S6_DEPTH_CHARTS.cell_notes: Backup identity only; prior-week chart under lag rule. Snap evidence outranks chart evidence where they differ.

primary_qb_id (S1/S2).basis: starter identification rate, fitting corpora pooled
primary_qb_id (S1/S2).restrictions: snap-derived starter (max offensive snaps); ties fail closed; 2012 unavailable at the named source (header-only file), so extended corpora effectively start 2013

qb_designation (S3).basis: determinable = report row present (any status) or team-week present in the injuries file
qb_designation (S3).restrictions: final-report cadence rule (cadence-inferred timing, no per-record publication receipt); no revision history; strict explicit-designation rows are a minority of team-games because healthy QBs carry no designation

qb_reserve (S5).basis: primary QB found in a prior-week roster snapshot
qb_reserve (S5).restrictions: prior-week lag rule strictly applied (Week 1 team-games uncovered); reserve subtype unresolved (opaque status_description_abbr codes, no codebook)

qb_practice_final (S4).basis: practice_status presence among injury-report rows (see per-season S4 counts)
qb_practice_final (S4).restrictions: weekly snapshot only; per-day progression not reconstructible; optional feature -- drop at design freeze if its value cannot be isolated (foundation S4)

backup_qb_id (S1/S6).basis: prior-week depth-chart QB2 identified rate; snap evidence (most recent fill-in starter) outranks the chart
backup_qb_id (S1/S6).restrictions: chart snapshot day inside the week is untimestamped; lag rule mandatory

absent_share_off/def (S2 x S3/S5).restrictions: trailing shares from completed games only, under the completion-window safeguard; same-game snaps never features

game_day_inactives (S7).basis: no trustworthy timestamped historical archive exists
game_day_inactives (S7).restrictions: forward-capture only; excluded from V2 per the parity rule and the owner's decision

report_revisions (S8).basis: no structured timestamped historical archive exists

sensitivity_schedule_corroborated_bridge.method: Starter identity additionally resolved when the snap-derived starter's name exactly equals the schedule's listed QB name for the same game/team (two independent sources agreeing). Strict pfr->gsis bridge remains the headline; this is a sensitivity, NOT the headline, because name matching has caused production identity incidents in this project.
sensitivity_schedule_corroborated_bridge.implication: The preregistration S8 Questionable-QB estimator gate (>=100) fails by one case (99) under the strict bridge and passes (105) under the corroborated bridge. The shortfall is an identity-resolution artifact, not a data-availability failure. Adopting the corroborated bridge is an owner decision at lock time.
